messages:
Anna D.: I opened a docs PR for private/on‑prem networking + KMS/HSM examples. Quick accuracy pass before merge? https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/498
Jasper: Linking. Can we add a short migration note for nftables users? A couple customers hit nftables vs iptables when running the installer.
Marco (infra): Yep. Also call out firewalld and podman network quirks. I'll paste the minimal nftables rules we used in the lab.
Anna D.: I left a TODO in the PR for nftables but haven't authored the snippet. Marco, can you drop the exact rule set?
Marco (infra): Pasted (tested on Rocky 9):

```
# allow control plane ports
nft add table inet redwood
nft add chain inet redwood input { type filter hook input priority 0; }
nft add rule inet redwood input tcp dport {443,6000,10250} ct state new,established accept
nft add rule inet redwood input udp dport 53 accept
```

Marco (infra): Note: 6000/tcp is our local KMS proxy port. Add it to preflight. Also warn about podman network namespaces - `podman system service` may isolate ports.
Elena (security): Add explicit note: HSM via PKCS#11 requires outbound TLS to KMS endpoints or a reachable HSM proxy. Document mutual TLS requirement for the HSM client and cert chain checks.
Samir: I'll add a tiny Python SDK snippet for calling the local KMS proxy with client certs.
Samir: Snippet:

```
import requests
s = requests.Session()
s.cert = ("/etc/redwood/certs/client.crt","/etc/redwood/certs/client.key")
resp = s.post("https://127.0.0.1:6000/v1/decrypt", json={"ciphertext":"BASE64"}, timeout=30)
print(resp.json())
```

Anna D.: Nice. Put that under "KMS examples". Also need a short troubleshooting blurb for air‑gapped installs importing runtime tarballs.
Jasper: Recommend both containerd and podman import commands and link to the archive format. Example: `sudo ctr -n=k8s.io images import redwood-runtime-1.4.2.tar` and `sudo podman load -i redwood-runtime-1.4.2.tar`
Anna D.: CI preview flagged a broken anchor to the releases page (docs/releases#runtime-1-4-2) — docs-bot shows a 404.
docs-bot: Automated check: broken anchor in sources/docs/onprem/setup.md -> line 142 (docs/releases#runtime-1-4-2).
Anna D.: Who can fix the release note anchor?
Marco (infra): That's in the release-notes repo; I can submit a tiny patch to restore the anchor name.
Elena (security): Please also add an MTU warning for site-to-site VPNs. We saw fragmentation issues when VXLAN + 1500 MTU collided. Suggest a table of recommended MTU (e.g., 1400 for VXLAN over VPN).
Samir: Small nit — examples originally used `timeout=5`. For private/onprem with HSM latency, set timeout=30 in examples.
Anna D.: Updating snippet and bumping timeout. Also adding FAQ entry: "HSM client fails first decrypt" with causes: clock skew, cert chain, DNS for private endpoints in air-gapped setups.
Marco (infra): For DNS, include the resolv.conf fallback we used: `options rotate timeout:2` plus a note about split-horizon DNS.
Jasper: When you push, squash the small WIP commits. Add migration line: "If switching kernels or nft->iptables compat, restart kubelet after rule import".
Elena (security): Approving from security once Samir's cert example is present and mTLS requirement is explicit.
Samir: Pushed cert example and timeout change.
Anna D.: I updated the PR: nftables block, SDK snippet (30s), image import commands, MTU note, and FAQ. Marco, please open the release anchor fix PR and I can merge after a quick sanity check.
Marco (infra): Will open the tiny release-notes PR in ~10m.
Anna D.: Preview passed and looks fine. infra-bot: Deploy preview succeeded — https://deploy-preview.docs.redwood-inference.internal/498 (visual diff: 3 files). Merging after infra PR lands. Thanks all!
